(Retrieved by recency; embedding similarity unavailable.) --- Title: Maya Protocol exploit drains bitcoin and other assets as pool value drops $11 million Link: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/19/maya-protocol-exploit-drains-bitcoin-and-other-assets-as-pool-value-drops-usd11-million A chain of six flaws caused the cross-chain trading network to credit a pool with nearly 50 million tokens that were never properly funded, letting an attacker drain real assets. --- Title: Robot maker Unitree’s IPO surges 600% , outpacing crypto traders’ premarket bets Link: https://www.coindesk.com/markets/2026/08/19/robot-maker-unitree-s-ipo-surges-600-outpacing-crypto-traders-premarket-bets A Hyperliquid perp priced Unitree far above its IPO valuation before Shanghai trading began, but the robot maker’s first public trade still opened roughly 75% above crypto traders’ implied price. --- Title: MAYAChain halts network after estimated $1.7M exploit Link: https://cointelegraph.com/news/maya-protocol-1-7m-exploit-network-halt?utm_source=rss_feed&utm_medium=rss&utm_campaign=rss_partner_inbound

A preliminary analysis says six chained bugs let a 23-message transaction drain 48.87 million CACAO, sending the token down nearly 89%.
